not_real.why: No "#1" appears in any text, card or file field. I checked the network titles ending in #1 against the Wikipedia summaries of each show's first episode, plus the doubtful cases (Ms. Marvel Damage Control, Wonder Man Cleary, AoS S6 space search, Team Thor shorts, What If...?, VisionQuest, Marvel Zombies), and each one is meant to start at episode 1.

Black Knife Cartel is supported: Wikipedia's Echo summary uses the name, and the fandom page shows the cartel's on-screen logo in episodes 2 to 5. The ordinary Battle of New York uses refer to 2012 and are not the fault. Only the Born Again "Battle for New York" is.

Karen's steps check out. Her arrest at the City Hall protest (Born Again S2E6) matches City Hall and dc-chp. She sets off the fire alarm at Sacred Saints Hospital in The Punisher S2, and Lewis Wilson takes her hostage at the hotel in The Punisher S1 (dc-nybomb). No place or case is wrong.

Noni's stages are right. Akeya, the Lion and Noni are in episode 1 (Into the Lion's Den), and the older Noni counsels B'Kai in episode 2 (Legends and Lies), so B'Kai|Noni at Eyes of Wakanda#2 is correct.

The data uses in-season numbers, and every Rosalind and Lash stage that names Garner is at S3#7, which is overall episode 51, Chaos Theory. Price shoots Lash and the ATCU takes him into custody in that episode, and Lash is revealed as Garner in S3E6 and S3E7, so episode 45 (S3E1) would be wrong and would spoil the reveal.
"Masters of the Mystic Arts" is said on screen (Wong to Wanda in Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness), and Kamar-Taj is used as a place, not a group name, so the group name is supported.
